events.headline: 9.92M HYPE (~$856M, ~4.5% of 222.45M circulating) unlocks to core contributors on Oct 6, 2026
events.eventClass: scheduled vesting unlock >= 2% of circulating within 7 days (scheduled unlock, not an observed sale)
events.relevance: Supply overhang lands in 2 days on a held coin sitting just above the NEAR entry zone; recurring monthly contributor vesting (prior tranche Sept 6), stacked on the separate 3.75M Labs OTC sale (~Oct 7). Argues against adding above the zone until absorption is visible.
events.sourceName: Crypto Economy; KuCoin News (citing Tokenomist); U.Today

events.headline: Hyperliquid Strategies (Nasdaq: PURR) buys another 1.9M HYPE for $167.2M; holdings ~37M HYPE (~$3.26B)
events.relevance: Largest HYPE treasury vehicle keeps absorbing supply (~0.5% of circulating in one buy) while price sits just above the NEAR entry zone; supports holding, does not by itself justify chasing above the zone.
events.sourceName: TokenPost (also PANews, KuCoin News; citing @HyperliquidNews X post; company press release not reachable)
